text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket put on an "awesome race" 
and won. Chants of "Ticket!" echoed across 
the racecourse, praising her victory.

Thrilled to have given the fans something 
to dream about, she is thoroughly 
satisfied. She vows to deliver an equally 
passionate race at the Kikuka Sho.

While congratulating Winning Ticket on her 
victory, both Narita Taishin and Biwa 
Hayahide declared that they would not lose 
next time.

Winning Ticket broke down in loud tears of 
emotion, feeling that she only won today's 
race thanks to them.
